chaosGods.title: The Chaos Gods
chaosGods.desc: Khorne (blood), Nurgle (pestilence), Tzeentch (change), and Slaanesh (excess). Warp entities fed by mortal emotion, they corrupt minds and unravel reality.

spaceMarines.title: Space Marines
spaceMarines.desc: Genetically engineered superhuman warriors, the Adeptus Astartes are the Imperium’s elite defenders. Organized into Chapters, they wield power armor and devastating weaponry.

astraMilitarum.title: Astra Militarum
astraMilitarum.desc: The galaxy’s largest army, made up of billions of human soldiers. Individually fragile, they prevail through sheer numbers, artillery, and armored might.

aeldari.title: Aeldari
aeldari.desc: An ancient xenos species of formidable psychic and martial prowess. The Craftworlds are survivors of a fallen empire, fighting to stave off extinction.

drukhari.title: Drukhari
drukhari.desc: Dark kin dwelling in Commorragh within the Webway. Sadistic raiders who feed on suffering to keep their souls from being claimed by Slaanesh.

necrons.title: Necrons
necrons.desc: Ancient tomb builders, a robotic race born of biotransference eons ago. They awaken from millennia of stasis to reclaim the galaxy they once ruled.

orks.title: Orks
orks.desc: Brutal creatures who live for war. Their ramshackle tech runs on collective belief, and their massive Waaagh!s tear through worlds in unrestrained violence.

chaos.title: Chaos
chaos.desc: Corrupted forces devoted to the Dark Gods of the Warp. Traitor marines, daemons, and cultists seek to shatter the Imperium and plunge the galaxy into anarchy.

tau.title: T'au Empire
tau.desc: A young xenos empire guided by the Greater Good. They use advanced technology and diplomacy to expand, while darker truths lurk behind their idealistic façade.

tyranids.title: Tyranids
tyranids.desc: Extragalactic swarms that devour biomass. A ravenous hive mind adapts its organisms to consume entire worlds, leaving nothing living behind.

error.lostInWarpDesc: The Geller Field has failed. Your vessel is adrift in the Immaterium. This path does not exist in the Emperor's records.
